Hi! How have you been? It's been a while since we last worked together. ^^

I really loved the last illustrations you've delivered to me so I was hoping to request another illustration!

I would like to request an illustration of my Vtuber for the sake of using the illustration for merchandise. The merchandise will be an acrylic key holder. I would like to be able to have it so the key holder can be two-sided rather than just having a design on one side, if possible!

If possible, something similar to the "feeling" of these past illustrations would be nice!
https://twitter.com/NeNe_Stamp/status/1746164259715948839/photo/4
https://twitter.com/NeNe_Stamp/status/1749020434379735504

Information about my Character that may help:
He is an energetic Vtuber who is always doing his best to bring joy to his fans by any means possible! He often does ASMR streams, is always working on projects to bring smiles to his fans in new and exciting ways and can fluctuate between being kind-hearted and being childish, smug and bratty.

If it would help to have Taiyou hold something in his pose, then maybe something like one of these ideas may help!
* A cup of bubble tea
* A plushy of a mouse with a pink bow on its head in reference to his Vtuber partner: https://twitter.com/_lulufleur/status/1755241133477638482/photo/1
* A Nintendo Switch/GameBoy Color/GameBoy Advance
* A disposable film camera or professional grade camera
* A mechanical keyboard with pastel colors

I leave the final decision on pose, expression, etc up to you!

ポージングはお任せしますが、できればお花も入れていただきたいです！SNSや非商用利用もお願いします。ありがとうございました(❁´◡`❁)
